svg.aria-label: Split scene: on the left a tired person sits with a drooping meter above and an unfinished puzzle on the table beside them, while a small robot offers a shortcut arrow. On the right, a large framed artwork labeled costs more hangs above a much smaller robot-stamped artwork labeled costs less, the two sides separated by a thin vertical line.
